text:
marta: Quick follow-up from the kernel selection & attention optimization RFC — wanted to capture post-RFC rollout controls and the action items after last week's canary hiccup. Link to RFC: <https://rfc.internal/kernel-attn-opt>
cheng: Saw the canary traces. When seq_len jumped we had 3x latency variance on the quantized path vs baseline, and a few OOM-ish backpressure signs.
sam: +1. We need per-model enablement + global guardrail. Minimal config idea:
```yaml
model_flags:
  gptx-7b-v2:
    enabled_kernels: ["fast-attn-2", "fallback-attn-v1"]
    rollout_percent: 20
    circuit_breaker:
      error_rate: 0.02
      p99_latency_ms: 500
```
kai: Question: do we manage flags per model-version or per route? My vote: per model-version (so we can pin rollouts to specific weights).
andre: Also add an immutable rollout_events table so we can audit who flipped what and when.
ops-bot: :warning: Canary alert triggered for gptx-7b-v2 @ 2026-03-18T09:12Z - auto-rollover to fallback-attn-v1 executed (policy: canary-automatic)
leah: Proposal for rollout policy: three tiers — (1) safe-default set (always enabled kernels), (2) staged rollout (canary -> ramp -> global), (3) emergency fallback (auto-swap to legacy kernel or CPU). Metric hooks required: `kernel_switch.count`, `kernel_switch.reason`, `kernel_latency.p50|p95|p99`.
marta: Action items & owners:
  - DB schema + audit table: @andre
  - Circuit-breaker logic + telemetry tags: @cheng
  - Ops escape hatch CLI & RBAC: @kai
  - Runbook and playbook doc: @leah
Target: landing POC within 2-week sprint. Objections?
sam: No objections. Add rule: block >50% global flips without safety review from runtime-lead.
cheng: Will attach a tracing tag `kernel.rollback_id` and ensure spans include `model_version` and `kernel_name`.
kai: For the escape hatch CLI I propose:
```
redwoodctl runtime flip --model gptx-7b-v2 --to fallback-attn-v1 --reason "p99 regression" --dry-run
```
RBAC enforced, logs append to rollout_events, and dry-run returns delta metrics.
marta: Also we need an eval harness to run key regression prompts immediately after a flip. I'll block 2 hours on Wed to design the harness and prompt set.
andre: I'll draft the rollout_events schema + sample migration today and open a PR by Mon.
leah: Ops runbook additions: when the canary alert fires, runtime-oncall runs quick checklist: confirm alert, check `kernel_switch.count`, validate traces, attempt manual flip to fallback, if p99 not reduced in 5 minutes escalate to infra and consider region failover.
marta: Great. I'll schedule a 30m sync Fri 10:00 to review PRs and the CLI UX. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
